rows.source_ko: 관세청 (행정관리담당관), 042-481-7682
rows.text_en: Korea Customs Service (Administrative Management Officer), 042-481-7682

rows.source_ko: 제1장 총칙
rows.text_en: Chapter 1 General Provisions

rows.source_ko: 제1조(목적) 이 규칙은 관세청과 그 소속기관의 조직ㆍ직무범위 기타 필요한 사항을 규정함을 목적으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe the organization, scope of duties, and other necessary matters of the Korea Customs Service and its affiliated agencies.
Chapter 2 Korea Customs Service <Amended Apr. 15, 2005>

rows.source_ko: 제1조의2(차장) 차장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 가등급으로 한다. <개정 2014. 1. 24.>
rows.text_en: Article 1-2 (Deputy Commissioner) The Deputy Commissioner shall be appointed from among general-service public officials in the Senior Civil Service, and the position shall be classified as Grade A. <Amended Jan. 24, 2014>
[This Article was newly established on Aug. 9, 2006.]

rows.source_ko: 제2조(대변인) 대변인은 부이사관 또는 서기관으로 보한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Spokesperson) The Spokesperson shall be appointed from among Deputy Directors-General or Directors.
[Wholly Amended Apr. 29, 2009]

rows.source_ko: 제3조(기획조정관) ① 기획조정관은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다. <개정 2008. 12. 31.>
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Director General of Planning and Coordination) ① The Director General of Planning and Coordination shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B. <Amended Dec. 31, 2008>

rows.source_ko: ② 기획조정관 밑에 기획재정담당관ㆍ행정관리담당관ㆍ법무담당관ㆍ비상안전담당관 및 납세자보호팀을 두며, 기획재정담당관ㆍ행정관리담당관 및 법무담당관은 부이사관 또는 서기관으로, 비상안전담당관은 임기제 서기관으로, 납세자보호팀장은 서기관 또는 행정사무관으로 보한다. <개정 2024. 2. 27.>
rows.text_en: ② The Director-General for Planning and Coordination shall have a Planning and Finance Officer, an Administrative Management Officer, a Legal Affairs Officer, an Emergency and Safety Officer, and a Taxpayer Protection Team. The Planning and Finance, Administrative Management and Legal Affairs Officers shall be Deputy Directors-General or Directors, the Emergency and Safety Officer shall be a fixed-term Director, and the Head of the Taxpayer Protection Team shall be a Director or Administrative Officer. <Amended Feb. 27, 2024>

③ The Director of Planning and Finance assists the Director of Planning and Coordination with respect to the following matters. <Amended Apr. 29, 2009; Dec. 27, 2012; Sep. 26, 2013; Oct. 31, 2017; Sep. 18, 2018; Mar. 30, 2021>

rows.source_ko: 1. 각종 정책과 계획의 수립ㆍ종합 및 조정
rows.text_en: 1. Formulation, synthesis, and coordination of various policies and plans

rows.source_ko: 2. 주요업무계획의 수립 및 조정
rows.text_en: 2. Establishment and Coordination of Major Business Plans

rows.source_ko: 3. 재정기획ㆍ운영에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning financial planning and operation

rows.source_ko: 4. 예산의 편성 및 집행의 조정
rows.text_en: 4. Coordination of budget formulation and execution

rows.source_ko: 5. 국회 관련된 업무의 총괄 및 조정
rows.text_en: 5. Overall management and coordination of National Assembly-related affairs
6. Deleted <December 28, 2021>
7. Deleted <February 27, 2024>
8. Deleted <February 27, 2024>
9. Deleted <February 27, 2024>
10. Deleted <March 30, 2021>
11. Deleted <March 30, 2021>
12. Deleted <March 30, 2021>
13. Deleted <March 30, 2021>
14. Deleted <March 30, 2021>
15. Deleted <March 30, 2021>
16. Deleted <March 30, 2021>

rows.source_ko: 17. 그 밖에 각 국 및 관내 다른 부서 업무의 총괄ㆍ조정에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 17. Other matters concerning the overall management and coordination of affairs of each bureau and other departments within the jurisdiction

rows.source_ko: ④ 행정관리담당관은 다음 사항에 관하여 기획조정관을 보좌한다. <개정 2021. 12. 28., 2024. 2. 27.>
rows.text_en: ④ The Administrative Management Officer shall assist the Director-General for Planning and Coordination with the following matters. <Amended Dec. 28, 2021; Feb. 27, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 1. 주요사업의 진도파악 및 그 결과에 대한 정부업무평가
rows.text_en: 1. Assessment of progress of major projects and government performance evaluation regarding the results

rows.source_ko: 2. 성과관리 기본계획의 수립ㆍ조정 및 총괄
rows.text_en: 2. Establishment, coordination, and overall management of the basic performance management plan

rows.source_ko: 3. 통합성과관리시스템의 구축 및 운영
rows.text_en: 3. Establishment and Operation of Integrated Performance Management System

rows.source_ko: 4. 성과관리 지표의 개발 및 평가
rows.text_en: 4. Development and Evaluation of Performance Management Indicators

rows.source_ko: 5. 행정제도 개선계획의 수립 및 집행
rows.text_en: 5. Establishment and execution of administrative system improvement plans

rows.source_ko: 6. 민원(국민제안을 포함한다) 관련 제도의 개선
rows.text_en: 6. Improvement of systems related to civil complaints (including citizen proposals)

rows.source_ko: 7. 관세행정과 관련된 규제개혁에 관한 업무
rows.text_en: 7. Matters concerning regulatory reform related to customs administration

rows.source_ko: 8. 업무처리절차 및 조직문화의 개선 등 청 내 창의행정업무의 총괄ㆍ지원
rows.text_en: 8. Overall management and support of creative administrative tasks within the Agency, including the improvement of work processing procedures and organizational culture

rows.source_ko: 9. 청 내 정부혁신 관련 과제 발굴ㆍ선정, 추진상황 확인ㆍ점검 및 성과관리
rows.text_en: 9. Identification and selection of government innovation-related tasks within the Agency, verification and monitoring of implementation status, and performance management

rows.source_ko: 10. 청 내 공공기관, 기업, 단체 등과의 행정협업 관련 업무의 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 10. Overall management and coordination of administrative collaboration tasks with public institutions, companies, organizations, etc. within the Agency

rows.source_ko: 11. 조직운영 기본계획의 수립
rows.text_en: 11. Establishment of Basic Plan for Organizational Operation

rows.source_ko: 12. 조직진단 및 평가를 통한 조직과 정원의 관리
rows.text_en: 12. Management of Organization and Staffing through Organizational Diagnosis and Evaluation

rows.source_ko: 13. 청 내 국가사무 민간위탁에 대한 관리ㆍ감독 등 총괄
rows.text_en: 13. Overall management and supervision of the outsourcing of state affairs to the private sector within the Agency

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 법무담당관은 다음 사항에 관하여 기획조정관을 보좌한다. <개정 2021. 12. 28., 2024. 2. 27.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Legal Affairs Officer assists the Director of Planning and Coordination with respect to the following matters. <Amended Dec. 28, 2021; Feb. 27, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 1. 법령안의 입안 및 심사
rows.text_en: 1. Drafting and examination of proposed laws and regulations

rows.source_ko: 2. 소송사무의 총괄
rows.text_en: 2. Overall management of litigation affairs

rows.source_ko: 3. 행정심판에 관한 사무의 총괄
rows.text_en: 3. Overall management of affairs regarding administrative appeals

rows.source_ko: 4. 법규집의 편찬 및 발간
rows.text_en: 4. Compilation and publication of the Code of Laws

rows.source_ko: 5. 법령질의 회신의 총괄
rows.text_en: 5. Coordination of replies to inquiries concerning laws and regulations

rows.source_ko: 6. 「관세법」 등(「외국환거래법」은 제외한다)에 따른 과태료 부과ㆍ징수 제도의 운영
rows.text_en: 6. Operation of the system for imposing and collecting administrative fines under the Customs Act , etc. ( excluding the Foreign Exchange Transactions Act )

rows.source_ko: 7. 관세심사청구 및 과세전적부심사에 관한 업무
rows.text_en: 7. Matters concerning requests for review of customs duties and pre-assessment review of taxation

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 비상안전담당관은 다음 사항에 관하여 기획조정관을 보좌한다. <개정 2009. 4. 29., 2013. 3. 23., 2022. 5. 31.>
rows.text_en: ⑥ The Emergency and Safety Officer shall assist the Director-General for Planning and Coordination with the following matters. <Amended Apr. 29, 2009; Mar. 23, 2013; May 31, 2022>

rows.source_ko: 1. 국가비상사태에 대비한 계획의 수립ㆍ종합 및 조정
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment, synthesis, and coordination of plans for national emergencies

rows.source_ko: 2. 정부비상훈련에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning government emergency drills

rows.source_ko: 2의2. 위기관리(안보ㆍ재난ㆍ국가기반) 업무 총괄
rows.text_en: 2-2. Overall management of crisis management (security, disaster, and national infrastructure) operations

rows.source_ko: 3. 직장예비군 및 민방위대의 관리
rows.text_en: 3. Management of Workplace Reserve Forces and Civil Defense Corps

rows.source_ko: 4. 청사ㆍ시설ㆍ장비의 안전관리에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning the safety management of office buildings, facilities, and equipment

rows.source_ko: 5. 방호계획의 총괄
rows.text_en: 5. Overview of the Protection Plan

rows.source_ko: 6. 사회복무요원 배정요청 및 복무관리 등에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Matters concerning requests for assignment of social service agents and service management, etc.

rows.source_ko: 7. 재난상황 및 위기상황 관리기관과의 연계체계 구축ㆍ운영
rows.text_en: 7. Establishment and operation of a linkage system with disaster and crisis management agencies

rows.source_ko: ⑦ 납세자보호팀장은 다음 사항에 관하여 기획조정관을 보좌한다. <신설 2024. 2. 27., 2025. 2. 25.>
rows.text_en: ⑦ The Head of the Taxpayer Protection Team shall assist the Director-General for Planning and Coordination with the following matters. <Newly added Feb. 27, 2024; Feb. 25, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 관세행정 관련 납세자 권리보호 제도ㆍ정책 운영
rows.text_en: 1. Operation of systems and policies for protecting taxpayer rights related to customs administration

rows.source_ko: 2. 관세행정 관련 납세자의 권리보호 요청 제도 운영
rows.text_en: 2. Operation of the System for Requesting Protection of Taxpayer Rights in Relation to Customs Administration

rows.source_ko: 3. 「관세법」 제118조의4에 따른 납세자보호위원회 운영
rows.text_en: 3. Operation of the Taxpayer Protection Committee pursuant to Article 118-4 of the Customs Act

rows.source_ko: 3의2. 관세상담 서비스 제공을 위한 고객지원센터의 운영
rows.text_en: 3-2. Operation of the Customer Support Center for the Provision of Customs Consultation Services

rows.source_ko: 3의3. 관세고객 상담을 통한 제도개선 사항의 수집 및 관리
rows.text_en: 3-3. Collection and Management of System Improvement Matters through Customs Customer Consultations

rows.source_ko: 4. 그 밖에 관세행정 관련 납세자 권리보호에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Other matters concerning the protection of taxpayer rights in relation to customs administration
[Wholly Amended Mar. 3, 2008]

rows.source_ko: 제3조의2(감사관) ① 감사관은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다. <개정 2008. 12. 31.>
rows.text_en: Article 3-2 (Auditor) ① The Auditor shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, provided that the job grade of the position is Grade B. <Amended Dec. 31, 2008>

rows.source_ko: ② 감사관 밑에 감사담당관 및 감찰팀장을 두되, 감사담당관은 부이사관 또는 서기관으로 보하고, 감찰팀장은 서기관 또는 행정사무관으로 보한다. <개정 2009. 4. 29.>
rows.text_en: ② The Auditor shall have an Audit Officer and the Head of an Inspection Team. The Audit Officer shall be a Deputy Director-General or Director, and the Head of the Inspection Team shall be a Director or Administrative Officer. <Amended Apr. 29, 2009>

rows.source_ko: ③ 감사담당관은 다음 사항에 관하여 감사관을 보좌한다. <개정 2009. 4. 29., 2010. 11. 17.>
rows.text_en: ③ The Audit Officer assists the Auditor in the following matters. <Amended Apr. 29, 2009; Nov. 17, 2010>

rows.source_ko: 1. 관세청과 그 소속기관 및 유관단체에 대한 감사
rows.text_en: 1. Audit of the Korea Customs Service, its affiliated agencies, and related organizations

rows.source_ko: 2. 다른 기관에 의한 관세청과 그 소속기관 및 유관단체에 대한 감사결과의 처리
rows.text_en: 2. Handling of audit results by other agencies regarding the Korea Customs Service, its affiliated agencies, and related organizations

rows.source_ko: 3. 소속 공무원의 재산등록 및 관세청장에게 위임된 재산등록 사항의 심사에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning the registration of assets of affiliated public officials and the examination of asset registration matters delegated to the Commissioner of the Korea Customs Service

rows.source_ko: 4. 감사에 관한 통계의 관리 및 분석
rows.text_en: 4. Management and Analysis of Audit Statistics

rows.source_ko: 5. 청장이 감사에 관하여 지시한 사항의 처리
rows.text_en: 5. Handling of matters instructed by the Commissioner regarding the audit

rows.source_ko: 6. 그 밖에 관내 다른 부서 업무의 총괄ㆍ조정에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Other matters concerning the overall management and coordination of affairs of other departments within the jurisdiction

rows.source_ko: ④ 감찰팀장은 다음 사항에 관하여 감사관을 보좌한다. <신설 2009. 4. 29.>
rows.text_en: ④ The Head of the Inspection Team assists the Auditor with respect to the following matters. <Newly added Apr. 29, 2009>

rows.source_ko: 1. 사정업무에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 1. Matters concerning inspection duties

rows.source_ko: 2. 공직윤리 확립에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning the establishment of public service ethics

rows.source_ko: 3. 소속공무원의 복무의무 위반사항의 조사 및 처리
rows.text_en: 3. Investigation and handling of violations of service obligations by affiliated public officials

rows.source_ko: 4. 소속공무원의 비위사항과 비위사항 관련 진정의 조사 및 처리
rows.text_en: 4. Investigation and handling of misconduct by affiliated public officials and complaints related to such misconduct

rows.source_ko: 5. 비위사항에 관한 정보의 수집 및 분석
rows.text_en: 5. Collection and analysis of information regarding misconduct

rows.source_ko: 6. 진정(비위관련 사항은 제외한다) 및 납세자 피해에 대한 조사 및 처분
rows.text_en: 6. Investigation and disposition regarding complaints (excluding matters related to misconduct) and taxpayer damages
[Wholly Amended Mar. 3, 2008]

rows.source_ko: 제3조의3(정보데이터정책관) ① 정보데이터정책관은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 3-3 (Director-General for Information and Data Policy) ① The Director-General for Information and Data Policy shall be appointed from among general-service public officials in the Senior Civil Service, and the position shall be classified as Grade B.

rows.source_ko: ② 정보데이터정책관 밑에 정보기획담당관ㆍ데이터담당관ㆍ인공지능혁신팀장ㆍ연구개발장비팀장 및 시스템운영팀장을 두며, 정보기획담당관 및 데이터담당관은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로, 인공지능혁신팀장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관 또는 행정사무관으로, 연구개발장비팀장 및 시스템운영팀장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ전산사무관ㆍ방송통신사무관 또는 행정사무관으로 보한다. <개정 2022. 5. 31., 2023. 8. 30., 2025. 9. 23.>
rows.text_en: ② Under the Director of Information and Data Policy, there shall be an Information Planning Officer, a Data Officer, a Team Leader for Artificial Intelligence Innovation, a Team Leader for Research and Development Equipment, and a Team Leader for System Operations. The Information Planning Officer and the Data Officer shall be appointed as Deputy Director-General, Senior Secretary for Science and Technology, or Senior Secretary; the Team Leader for Artificial Intelligence Innovation shall be appointed as Senior Secretary for Science and Technology, Senior Secretary, or Administrative Officer; and the Team Leader for Research and Development Equipment and the Team Leader for System Operations shall be appointed as Senior Secretary for Science and Technology, Senior Secretary, Computer Science Officer, Broadcasting and Telecommunications Officer, or Administrative Officer. <Amended May 31, 2022; August 30, 2023; September 23, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ③ 정보기획담당관은 다음 사항에 관하여 정보데이터정책관을 보좌한다. <개정 2025. 9. 23.>
rows.text_en: ③ The Information Planning Officer shall assist the Director-General for Information and Data Policy with the following matters. <Amended Sep. 23, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 관세행정정보화기본계획의 수립
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment of the Basic Plan for Customs Administration Informatization

rows.source_ko: 2. 관세행정의 정보화사업 기획 및 전산 관련 업무에 대한 지도ㆍ감독
rows.text_en: 2. Planning of informatization projects in customs administration and guidance and supervision of computer-related tasks

rows.source_ko: 3. 관세행정 정보화사업 예산의 심의ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 3. Deliberation and adjustment of the budget for customs administration informatization projects

rows.source_ko: 4. 관세행정 정보화와 관련된 사업의 관리
rows.text_en: 4. Management of projects related to the informatization of customs administration

rows.source_ko: 5. 관세행정 정보자원의 관리 및 운영
rows.text_en: 5. Management and Operation of Customs Administration Information Resources

rows.source_ko: 6. 국가관세종합정보시스템의 개발
rows.text_en: 6. Development of the National Customs Information System

rows.source_ko: 7. 국가관세종합정보시스템의 운영을 위한 장비도입 및 예산의 집행
rows.text_en: 7. Equipment introduction and budget execution for the operation of the National Customs Information System

rows.source_ko: 8. 국가관세종합정보시스템 해외보급 관련 정책 수립 및 시행에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 8. Matters concerning the establishment and implementation of policies related to the overseas distribution of the National Customs Information System

rows.source_ko: 9. 국가관세종합정보시스템 관련 정보기술의 해외보급ㆍ확산 및 동향조사
rows.text_en: 9. Overseas Dissemination, Diffusion, and Trend Survey of Information Technology Related to the National Customs Information System

rows.source_ko: 10. 국가관세종합정보시스템 해외보급 관련 국제기구 및 외국정부와의 협력에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 10. Matters concerning cooperation with international organizations and foreign governments regarding the overseas dissemination of the National Customs Information System

rows.source_ko: 11. 관세행정 정보화 교육계획의 수립 및 운영
rows.text_en: 11. Establishment and Operation of Customs Administration Informatization Training Plan

rows.source_ko: 12. 전자문서중계사업자의 지정 및 관리
rows.text_en: 12. Designation and Management of Electronic Document Intermediary Service Providers

rows.source_ko: 13. 한국관세정보원에 대한 지도ㆍ감독
rows.text_en: 13. Guidance and Supervision of the Korea Customs Information Service

rows.source_ko: 14. 그 밖에 관내 다른 부서 업무의 총괄ㆍ조정에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 14. Other matters concerning the overall management and coordination of affairs of other departments within the jurisdiction

rows.source_ko: ④ 데이터담당관은 다음 사항에 관하여 정보데이터정책관을 보좌한다. <개정 2025. 9. 23.>
rows.text_en: ④ The Data Officer shall assist the Director-General for Information and Data Policy with the following matters. <Amended Sep. 23, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 관세행정 관련 데이터 정책ㆍ제도의 연구ㆍ기획 및 개발에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 1. Matters concerning the research, planning, and development of data policies and systems related to customs administration

rows.source_ko: 2. 관세행정 관련 데이터 품질관리 정책의 수립 및 추진
rows.text_en: 2. Establishment and Implementation of Data Quality Management Policies Related to Customs Administration

rows.source_ko: 3. 관세행정 데이터 웨어하우스(data warehouse) 운영 및 응용프로그램 유지보수에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning the operation of the customs administration data warehouse and the maintenance of application programs

rows.source_ko: 4. 청 내 공공데이터의 제공 및 이용 활성화에 관한 계획의 수립ㆍ추진 및 평가 등 총괄
rows.text_en: 4. Overall management of the establishment, implementation, and evaluation of plans regarding the provision and promotion of the use of public data within the Agency

rows.source_ko: 5. 청 내 데이터기반행정 활성화를 위한 계획의 수립ㆍ추진 및 데이터 관리 등 총괄
rows.text_en: 5. Overall management of planning, implementation, and data management for the activation of data-based administration within the Agency

rows.source_ko: 6. 무역통계업무 총괄
rows.text_en: 6. Overall management of trade statistics

rows.source_ko: 7. 무역통계부호의 관리
rows.text_en: 7. Management of Trade Statistics Codes

rows.source_ko: 8. 통계 작성ㆍ교부 업무 대행기관 지정 및 관리
rows.text_en: 8. Designation and Management of Agencies for Statistics Compilation and Distribution

rows.source_ko: 9. 수출입통관자료의 분석ㆍ관리ㆍ제공 및 공표
rows.text_en: 9. Analysis, Management, Provision, and Publication of Import and Export Customs Clearance Data

rows.source_ko: 10. 수출입물가지수에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 10. Matters concerning the import and export price index

rows.source_ko: 11. 수출입 동향관리 및 발표
rows.text_en: 11. Management and Announcement of Import and Export Trends

rows.source_ko: 12. 수입물품의 평균신고가격 및 반입수량의 공표
rows.text_en: 12. Publication of Average Declared Value and Imported Quantity of Imported Goods

rows.source_ko: 13. 「경제안보를 위한 공급망 안정화 지원 기본법」 제15조제1항에 따른 조기경보시스템의 운영
rows.text_en: 13. Operation of the early warning system pursuant to Article 15, Paragraph 1 of the Framework Act on Support for Supply Chain Stabilization for Economic Security

rows.source_ko: 14. 세계관세기구 데이터모델 관련 업무에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 14. Matters concerning work related to the World Customs Organization data model

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 인공지능혁신팀장은 다음 사항에 관하여 정보데이터정책관을 보좌한다. <개정 2025. 9. 23.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Head of the Artificial Intelligence Innovation Team shall assist the Director-General for Information and Data Policy with the following matters. <Amended Sep. 23, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 관세행정 관련 인공지능ㆍ빅데이터 도입 사업의 총괄 관리
rows.text_en: 1. Overall management of AI and big data introduction projects related to customs administration

rows.source_ko: 2. 관세행정 관련 인공지능ㆍ빅데이터 시스템의 구축ㆍ운영 및 유지ㆍ관리
rows.text_en: 2. Establishment, Operation, Maintenance, and Management of Artificial Intelligence and Big Data Systems Related to Customs Administration

rows.source_ko: 3. 관세행정 관련 인공지능ㆍ빅데이터 활용 과제 발굴, 수행 및 기술 지원
rows.text_en: 3. Identification, execution, and technical support of projects utilizing artificial intelligence and big data related to customs administration

rows.source_ko: 4. 관세행정 관련 업무자동화(RPA) 과제 발굴, 수행 및 기술 지원
rows.text_en: 4. Identification, execution, and technical support of RPA projects related to customs administration

rows.source_ko: 5. 관세행정 관련 인공지능 활용 및 빅데이터 분석 역량 강화에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 5. Matters concerning the utilization of artificial intelligence and the strengthening of big data analysis capabilities related to customs administration

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 연구개발장비팀장은 다음 사항에 관하여 정보데이터정책관을 보좌한다. <개정 2022. 5. 31., 2025. 9. 23., 2026. 7. 1.>
rows.text_en: ⑥ The Head of the Research and Development Equipment Team shall assist the Director-General for Information and Data Policy with the following matters. <Amended May 31, 2022; Sep. 23, 2025; Jul. 1, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 1. 신기술을 활용한 관세행정 정보화 추진에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 1. Matters concerning the promotion of customs administration informatization using new technologies

rows.source_ko: 1의2. 통관감시장비 예산의 편성ㆍ심의 및 조정
rows.text_en: 1-2. Formulation, Deliberation, and Adjustment of Budget for Customs Surveillance Equipment

rows.source_ko: 2. 통관감시장비의 도입, 유지 및 성능 개선에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning the introduction, maintenance, and performance improvement of customs surveillance equipment

rows.source_ko: 3. 관세행정 분야 과학기술진흥을 위한 시책 수립 및 연구개발사업 추진에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning the establishment of policies and the promotion of research and development projects for the advancement of science and technology in the field of customs administration

rows.source_ko: 4. 관세행정 분야 연구개발과 관련된 국내외 기관과의 교류 및 협력
rows.text_en: 4. Exchange and cooperation with domestic and international institutions related to research and development in the field of customs administration

rows.source_ko: 5. 관세행정 분야 연구개발사업 예산의 편성ㆍ심의 및 조정
rows.text_en: 5. Formulation, deliberation, and adjustment of the budget for research and development projects in the field of customs administration

rows.source_ko: ⑦ 시스템운영팀장은 다음 사항에 관하여 정보데이터정책관을 보좌한다. <개정 2025. 9. 23.>
rows.text_en: ⑦ The Head of the System Operations Team shall assist the Director-General for Information and Data Policy with the following matters. <Amended Sep. 23, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 통합데이터베이스의 구축ㆍ운영 및 관리
rows.text_en: 1. Construction, Operation, and Management of the Integrated Database

rows.source_ko: 2. 국가관세종합정보시스템의 관리 및 운영
rows.text_en: 2. Management and Operation of the National Customs Information System

rows.source_ko: 3. 국가관세종합정보시스템 내 데이터의 관리
rows.text_en: 3. Management of data within the National Customs Information System

rows.source_ko: 4. 국가관세종합정보시스템 전자문서 및 유통시스템 관리에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning the management of the National Customs Information System's electronic documents and distribution system

rows.source_ko: 5. 국가관세종합정보시스템의 재난 관리에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 5. Matters concerning disaster management of the National Customs Information System

rows.source_ko: 6. 관세행정 개인정보보호 관련 정책의 수립ㆍ총괄 및 조정
rows.text_en: 6. Establishment, overall management, and coordination of policies related to personal information protection in customs administration

rows.source_ko: 7. 관세행정 통합보안관제센터의 운영 및 정보보안에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 7. Matters concerning the operation of the Customs Administration Integrated Security Control Center and information security

rows.source_ko: 8. 국가 간 통관망 연계에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 8. Matters concerning the linkage of cross-border customs networks

rows.source_ko: 9. 전자통관 조기경보시스템의 구축 및 운영
rows.text_en: 9. Establishment and Operation of the Electronic Customs Early Warning System

rows.source_ko: 10. 인터넷통관포털의 이용에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 10. Matters concerning the use of the Internet Customs Portal

rows.source_ko: 11. 전산장비 관리
rows.text_en: 11. Computer Equipment Management

rows.source_ko: 12. 통신망 및 통신장비 관리
rows.text_en: 12. Management of Communication Networks and Communication Equipment

rows.source_ko: 13. 기술지원센터 관리에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 13. Matters concerning the management of the Technical Support Center

rows.source_ko: 14. 온나라시스템 및 인터넷 홈페이지의 운영
rows.text_en: 14. Operation of the Onnara System and Internet Homepage

rows.source_ko: 15. 영상회의 및 원격업무시스템의 운영
rows.text_en: 15. Operation of Video Conferencing and Remote Work Systems
[Wholly Amended Mar. 30, 2021]

rows.source_ko: 제3조의4(관세국경위험관리센터장) 관세국경위험관리센터장은 부이사관 또는 서기관으로 보한다. <개정 2019. 2. 28.>
rows.text_en: Article 3-4 (Head of Customs Border Risk Management Center) The Head of the Customs Border Risk Management Center shall be appointed from among Deputy Directors-General or Directors. <Amended Feb. 28, 2019>

[This Article was newly added on Feb. 28, 2017.]
[Formerly Article 3-4 was moved to Article 3-5 <February 28, 2017>]
Article 3-5 Deleted <May 31, 2022>

rows.source_ko: 제3조의6(운영지원과) 운영지원과장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로 보한다. <개정 2023. 8. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 3-6 (Operations Support Division) The Head of the Operations Support Division shall be appointed from among Deputy Directors-General, Science and Technology Directors or Directors. <Amended Aug. 30, 2023>

[Wholly Amended Mar. 3, 2008]
[Moved from Article 3-5 <July 14, 2020>]

rows.source_ko: 제4조(통관국) ① 통관국장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Customs Clearance Bureau) ① The Director-General of the Customs Clearance Bureau shall be a general-service public official in the Senior Civil Service, with the position classified as Grade B.

rows.source_ko: ② 통관국에 통관기획과ㆍ관세국경감시과ㆍ통관검사과ㆍ전자상거래통관과 및 보세산업과를 두되, 통관기획과장ㆍ통관검사과장ㆍ전자상거래통관과장 및 보세산업과장은 부이사관 또는 서기관으로 보하고, 관세국경감시과장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로 보한다. <개정 2023. 8. 30., 2025. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: ② The Customs Clearance Bureau shall have a Customs Clearance Planning Division, Customs Border Surveillance Division, Customs Inspection Division, E-commerce Customs Clearance Division and Bonded Industry Division. The heads of the Customs Clearance Planning, Customs Inspection, E-commerce Customs Clearance and Bonded Industry Divisions shall be Deputy Directors-General or Directors; the Head of the Customs Border Surveillance Division shall be a Deputy Director-General, Science and Technology Director or Director. <Amended Aug. 30, 2023; Dec. 30, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ③ 통관기획과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2025. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: ③ The Head of the Customs Clearance Planning Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Dec. 30, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 수출입통관 전반의 정책ㆍ제도의 기획 및 운영
rows.text_en: 1. Planning and operation of policies and systems for overall import and export customs clearance

rows.source_ko: 2. 수입물품ㆍ수출물품ㆍ반송물품 및 중계무역물품의 통관에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning the customs clearance of imported goods, exported goods, returned goods, and transit trade goods

rows.source_ko: 3. 관세감면ㆍ분할납부 등 사전세액심사대상물품의 통관에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning the customs clearance of goods subject to prior tax assessment, such as customs duty reduction and installment payments

rows.source_ko: 4. 관세사의 관리 및 감독
rows.text_en: 4. Management and Supervision of Customs Brokers

rows.source_ko: 5. 전자문서에 의한 수출입통관 관리정책(정보기술분야는 제외한다)의 수립
rows.text_en: 5. Establishment of export and import customs clearance management policies using electronic documents (excluding the information technology sector)

rows.source_ko: 6. 불공정수출입행위의 방지를 위한 통관제도의 기획
rows.text_en: 6. Planning of the customs clearance system to prevent unfair import and export practices

rows.source_ko: 7. 세계무역기구협정 및 「세관절차의 간소화 및 조화에 관한 국제협약」 등 수출입통관과 관련된 국제협약의 이행에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 7. Matters concerning the implementation of international agreements related to import and export customs clearance, such as the World Trade Organization Agreement and the International Convention on the Simplification and Harmonization of Customs Procedures

rows.source_ko: 8. 통관절차 등과 관련된 외국인투자의 지원
rows.text_en: 8. Support for foreign investment related to customs clearance procedures, etc.

rows.source_ko: 9. 수출입통관과 관련된 물류전반 정책ㆍ제도의 기획 및 운영
rows.text_en: 9. Planning and operation of overall logistics policies and systems related to import and export customs clearance

rows.source_ko: 10. 수출입물류업체의 법규수행능력 측정 및 관리
rows.text_en: 10. Measurement and Management of Legal Compliance Capabilities of Import/Export Logistics Companies

rows.source_ko: 11. 이사화물의 통관에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 11. Matters concerning the customs clearance of household goods
12. Deleted <July 1, 2021>
13. Deleted <July 1, 2021>

rows.source_ko: 14. 보세구역 특허제도의 기획 및 보세창고 운영에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 14. Matters concerning the planning of the bonded area licensing system and the operation of bonded warehouses

rows.source_ko: 15. 그 밖에 국내 다른 부서 업무의 총괄ㆍ조정에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 15. Overall management and coordination of the work of other divisions within the bureau

rows.source_ko: ④ 관세국경감시과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ④ The Head of the Customs and Border Surveillance Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 총기류ㆍ폭발물 등 테러관련 물품 및 밀수품 반입방지 등 관세국경감시에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 1. Matters concerning customs border surveillance, such as the prevention of the entry of terrorism-related goods, including firearms and explosives, and smuggled goods

rows.source_ko: 2. 항공기ㆍ선박의 입출항 및 검색에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning the entry, exit, and inspection of aircraft and vessels

rows.source_ko: 3. 관세국경 출입 차량의 입출경 및 검색에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning the entry, exit, and inspection of vehicles entering and exiting customs borders

rows.source_ko: 4. 공항 및 항만의 국제항과 국제항 안의 보세구역에 대한 감시ㆍ조사
rows.text_en: 4. Monitoring and inspection of international ports at airports and seaports, and bonded areas within international ports

rows.source_ko: 5. 국제항 안에서 물품 및 용역의 공급을 업으로 하는 자에 대한 등록 및 관리
rows.text_en: 5. Registration and management of persons engaged in the business of supplying goods and services within international ports

rows.source_ko: 6. 여행자에 대한 자율적 법규준수도의 측정 및 관리
rows.text_en: 6. Measurement and Management of Travelers' Voluntary Compliance with Regulations

rows.source_ko: 7. 관세국경감시와 관련한 세관시설(청사 및 창고부지를 포함한다) 선정 및 운영의 적정성 확인 및 관리
rows.text_en: 7. Verification and management of the appropriateness of the selection and operation of customs facilities (including office buildings and warehouse sites) related to customs border surveillance

rows.source_ko: 8. 선박용품 및 항공기용품의 관리
rows.text_en: 8. Management of Ship and Aircraft Supplies

rows.source_ko: 9. 관리대상화물 중 감시대상화물의 관리에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 9. Matters concerning management of cargo designated for surveillance among cargo subject to control

rows.source_ko: 10. 수입화물(환적화물을 포함한다)의 입항ㆍ하역ㆍ보관 및 운송의 관리
rows.text_en: 10. Management of the arrival, loading/unloading, storage, and transportation of imported cargo (including transshipment cargo)

rows.source_ko: 11. 보세구역 장치기간경과물품ㆍ몰수품 및 국고귀속물품의 관리 및 매각
rows.text_en: 11. Management and Sale of Goods Exceeding Bonded Area Storage Periods, Confiscated Goods, and Goods Reverted to the State Treasury

rows.source_ko: 12. 수출입화물 총량관리 및 보세구역 위험관리에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 12. Matters concerning the management of total volume of import and export cargo and risk management of bonded areas

rows.source_ko: 13. 보세화물(컨테이너를 포함한다)의 관리
rows.text_en: 13. Management of bonded goods (including containers)

rows.source_ko: 14. 자율관리보세구역 및 보세사의 관리
rows.text_en: 14. Management of self-managed bonded areas and bonded cargo managers

rows.source_ko: 15. 여행자(항공기ㆍ선박 등의 승무원을 포함한다. 이하 같다)의 휴대품 검사 및 통관에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 15. Matters concerning the inspection and customs clearance of personal belongings of travelers (including crew members of aircraft, vessels, etc.; hereinafter the same applies)

rows.source_ko: 2. 시중유통 수입물품과 수입원료 사용 국내생산물품의 원산지표시 검사
rows.text_en: 2. Inspection of country-of-origin labeling on imported goods distributed in domestic markets and domestically produced goods using imported raw materials

rows.source_ko: 3. 「남북교류협력에 관한 법률」에 따른 원산지표시 제도 운영
rows.text_en: 3. Operation of the country-of-origin labeling system under the Inter-Korean Exchange and Cooperation Act

rows.source_ko: 4. 원산지표시와 관련된 국제협력ㆍ협약의 이행에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning implementation of international cooperation and agreements relating to country-of-origin labeling

rows.source_ko: 5. 수입물품(「농수산물의 원산지 표시에 관한 법률」 제10조의2제1항 및 「수산물 유통의 관리 및 지원에 관한 법률」 제31조제1항에 따라 고시되는 수입물품은 제외한다)의 유통이력관리 제도의 운영
rows.text_en: 5. Operation of the distribution history management system for imported goods (excluding imported goods publicly notified under Article 10-2 (1) of the Act on Origin Labeling of Agricultural and Fishery Products and Article 31 (1) of the Act on the Management of and Support for Distribution of Fishery Products)

rows.source_ko: 5의2. 수입물품의 유통이력 조사의 기획ㆍ지휘ㆍ감독
rows.text_en: 5-2. Planning, direction and supervision of investigations into the distribution history of imported goods

rows.source_ko: 6. 관세감면, 분할납부 물품 및 용도세율 적용물품의 사후관리
rows.text_en: 6. Post-clearance management of goods subject to customs duty reductions, installment payments or duty rates based on designated use

rows.source_ko: 7. 수입물품 상설판매장에 대한 지도ㆍ감독
rows.text_en: 7. Guidance and supervision of permanent sales outlets for imported goods

rows.source_ko: 8. 사전세액심사 대상의 지정 및 운영
rows.text_en: 8. Designation and operation of items subject to prior tax assessment

rows.source_ko: 9. 농수산물 수출입 관련 기획심사 및 지도ㆍ감독
rows.text_en: 9. Planned audits and guidance and supervision concerning imports and exports of agricultural and fishery products

rows.source_ko: 10. 덤핑 및 우회덤핑거래 심사 제도의 기획ㆍ운영
rows.text_en: 10. Planning and operation of systems for investigation of dumping and circumvention of anti-dumping measures

rows.source_ko: 10의2. 덤핑 및 우회덤핑거래 정보의 수집ㆍ분석 및 관리
rows.text_en: 10-2. Collection, analysis and management of information on dumping and circumvention of anti-dumping measures

rows.source_ko: 11. 덤핑방지관세 연례재검토 기획ㆍ운영 및 자료분석
rows.text_en: 11. Planning and operation of annual reviews of anti-dumping duties and related data analysis

rows.source_ko: 12. 보세구역 반입명령제도 기획ㆍ운영
rows.text_en: 12. Planning and operation of the system for orders to bring goods into bonded areas
⑦ Deleted <Apr. 29, 2009>

[Wholly Amended Nov. 22, 2003]
[Title Amended Mar. 30, 2021]

rows.source_ko: 제6조(조사국) ①조사국장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다. <개정 2005. 4. 15., 2006. 6. 30., 2006. 8. 9., 2008. 12. 31., 2021. 3. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Investigation Bureau) ① The Director-General of the Investigation Bureau shall be appointed from among general-service public officials in the Senior Civil Service, with the position classified as Grade B. <Amended Apr. 15, 2005; Jun. 30, 2006; Aug. 9, 2006; Dec. 31, 2008; Mar. 30, 2021>

rows.source_ko: ② 조사국에 조사총괄과ㆍ외환조사과ㆍ국제조사과 및 무역안보조사팀을 두되, 조사총괄과장ㆍ외환조사과장 및 국제조사과장은 부이사관 또는 서기관으로 보하고, 무역안보조사팀장은 서기관 또는 행정사무관으로 보한다. <개정 2021. 3. 30., 2026. 2. 19.>
rows.text_en: ② The Investigation Bureau shall have an Investigation Coordination Division, Foreign Exchange Investigation Division, International Investigation Division and Trade Security Investigation Team. The heads of the first three divisions shall be Deputy Directors-General or Directors; the Head of the Trade Security Investigation Team shall be a Director or Administrative Officer. <Amended Mar. 30, 2021; Feb. 19, 2026>

③ The Head of the Investigation Coordination Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Apr. 29, 2009; Dec. 30, 2009; Nov. 17, 2010; Feb. 28, 2017; Mar. 30, 2021; Dec. 19, 2023; Feb. 25, 2025; Feb. 19, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 1. 「관세법」 위반사범(이하 “관세범”이라 한다)에 관한 범칙수사업무의 기획ㆍ지도ㆍ조정 및 통고처분 등의 심리(審理)에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 1. Planning, guidance and coordination of investigations into customs offenses under the Customs Act (hereinafter referred to as “customs offenders”), and examination of notification dispositions and related matters
2. Deleted <Feb. 19, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 3. 금수품(국가기밀에 관한 문서 및 물품, 위조화폐, 음란도서 및 물품 등을 말한다. 이하 같다)에 관한 범칙수사업무의 기획ㆍ지도 및 조정
rows.text_en: 3. Planning, guidance and coordination of investigations into offenses involving prohibited goods (meaning documents and goods concerning national secrets, counterfeit currency, obscene publications and goods, etc.; hereinafter the same applies)

rows.source_ko: 4. 지식재산권 침해사범에 대한 범칙수사업무의 기획ㆍ지도 및 조정
rows.text_en: 4. Planning, guidance and coordination of investigations into offenses involving infringement of intellectual property rights

rows.source_ko: 4의2. 「멸종위기에 처한 야생동식물의 국제거래에 관한 협약」(CITES) 위반사범에 대한 범칙수사업무의 기획ㆍ지도 및 조정
rows.text_en: 4-2. Planning, guidance and coordination of investigations into offenses involving violations of the Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species of Wild Fauna and Flora (CITES)

rows.source_ko: 4의3. 폐기물 밀수단속 등 환경범죄 사범에 관한 범칙수사업무의 기획ㆍ지도 및 조정(관세청 소관사항에 한정한다)
rows.text_en: 4-3. Planning, guidance and coordination of investigations into environmental offenses, including crackdowns on waste smuggling (limited to matters under the jurisdiction of the Korea Customs Service)

rows.source_ko: 5. 사이버밀수 범칙수사업무의 기획ㆍ지도 및 조정
rows.text_en: 5. Planning, guidance and coordination of investigations into cyber smuggling offenses

rows.source_ko: 6. 압수물품의 보관ㆍ관리 제도의 운영 및 기획
rows.text_en: 6. Planning and operation of systems for storage and management of seized goods

rows.source_ko: 7. 범칙조사시스템의 운영 및 범칙통계의 관리(범칙자 및 우범자에 대한 신원관리를 포함한다)
rows.text_en: 7. Operation of the customs offense investigation system and management of offense statistics (including identity information on offenders and persons suspected of offenses)

rows.source_ko: 8. 밀수동향 관련 정보시스템의 개발ㆍ 운영
rows.text_en: 8. Development and operation of information systems on smuggling trends
9. Deleted <Sep. 18, 2018>

rows.source_ko: 10. 조사정보업무 총괄
rows.text_en: 10. Overall management of investigation intelligence operations

rows.source_ko: 11. 관세청장이 특별히 지시한 사항의 조사ㆍ수사 및 조정
rows.text_en: 11. Investigations, criminal investigations and coordination of matters specifically directed by the Commissioner of the Korea Customs Service

rows.source_ko: 12. 범칙수사 및 밀수단속과 관련된 국제공조 및 협력
rows.text_en: 12. International coordination and cooperation relating to investigations of offenses and anti-smuggling enforcement

rows.source_ko: 13. 제1호부터 제4호까지, 제4호의2, 제4호의3, 제5호 및 제15호와 관련된 국내ㆍ외 정보의 수집ㆍ분석 및 관리
rows.text_en: 13. Collection, analysis and management of domestic and overseas information relating to subparagraphs 1 through 4, 4-2, 4-3, 5 and 15

rows.source_ko: 14. 수사 장비의 배치 및 운용에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 14. Matters concerning deployment and operation of investigation equipment

rows.source_ko: 15. 「식품위생법」 등 보건 관련 법규 위반사범(수입물품과 관련된 죄를 범한 자로 한정한다)에 대한 범칙수사업무의 기획ㆍ지도 및 조정
rows.text_en: 15. Planning, guidance and coordination of investigations into offenses under the Food Sanitation Act and other public health-related laws (limited to persons committing offenses involving imported goods)
16. Deleted <Feb. 19, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 17. 통신판매중개자에 대한 부정수입물품의 유통 관련 서면실태 조사 및 공표에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 17. Matters concerning written surveys and publication of the status of online sales intermediaries' distribution of unlawfully imported goods

rows.source_ko: 18. 그 밖에 국내 다른 부서 업무의 총괄ㆍ조정에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 18. Overall management and coordination of the affairs of other divisions within the bureau
④ Deleted <Mar. 30, 2021>

⑤ The Head of the Foreign Exchange Investigation Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Apr. 29, 2009; Nov. 15, 2016; Sep. 18, 2018; Mar. 30, 2021; May 19, 2023; Feb. 19, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 1. 외국환거래 검사(「외국환거래법 시행령」 제35조제4항제3호에 따라 관세청장에게 위탁된 업무 및 같은 조 제10항부터 제16항까지에 규정된 공동검사 업무로 한정한다)에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 1. Matters concerning examinations of foreign exchange transactions (limited to duties entrusted to the Commissioner of the Korea Customs Service under Article 35 (4) 3 of the Enforcement Decree of the Foreign Exchange Transactions Act and joint examinations under Article 35 (10) through (16) thereof)

rows.source_ko: 2. 환전영업자에 대한 지도ㆍ감독ㆍ검사 및 범칙수사에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning guidance, supervision, inspection and investigations of offenses involving money exchange businesses

rows.source_ko: 3. 「외국환거래법」 위반사범에 관한 범칙수사업무의 기획ㆍ지도 및 조정
rows.text_en: 3. Planning, guidance and coordination of investigations into violations of the Foreign Exchange Transactions Act

rows.source_ko: 4. 범죄수익 등 불법자금 세탁행위 단속 업무의 기획ㆍ지도 및 조정
rows.text_en: 4. Planning, guidance and coordination of enforcement against laundering of criminal proceeds and other illicit funds

rows.source_ko: 5. 「외국환거래법」에 따른 행정처분 및 과태료 부과ㆍ징수제도의 운영
rows.text_en: 5. Operation of the system for administrative dispositions and the imposition and collection of administrative fines under the Foreign Exchange Transactions Act

rows.source_ko: 6. 외국환거래관련 정보자료의 수집ㆍ분석 및 관리
rows.text_en: 6. Collection, analysis and management of information and data concerning foreign exchange transactions

rows.source_ko: 7. 불법외국환거래에 관한 조사기법의 개발
rows.text_en: 7. Development of methods for investigating illegal foreign exchange transactions

rows.source_ko: 8. 불법외국환거래의 조사와 관련된 국내외 정보의 수집ㆍ분석 및 관리
rows.text_en: 8. Collection, analysis and management of domestic and international information relating to investigations of illegal foreign exchange transactions

rows.source_ko: 9. 특정금융거래정보의 수집 및 관리
rows.text_en: 9. Collection and management of specified financial transaction information

rows.source_ko: 10. 대외거래관련 통관 및 외환거래 정보분석시스템의 운영
rows.text_en: 10. Operation of the information analysis system for customs clearance and foreign exchange transactions related to international trade

rows.source_ko: 11. 관세범(「관세법」 제270조의2를 위반한 자로 한정한다)에 대한 범칙수사 업무의 기획ㆍ지도 및 조정
rows.text_en: 11. Planning, guidance and coordination of investigations into customs offenses (limited to persons violating Article 270-2 of the Customs Act)

rows.source_ko: 12. 재산국외도피사범 조사 업무의 기획ㆍ지도 및 조정
rows.text_en: 12. Planning, guidance and coordination of investigations into unlawful flight of assets overseas

rows.source_ko: 13. 「대외무역법」 등 무역관련법규 위반사범(이하 “무역사범”이라 한다) 중 「대외무역법」 제43조를 위반한 자에 대한 범칙수사 업무의 기획ㆍ지도 및 조정
rows.text_en: 13. Planning, guidance and coordination of investigations into trade offenses (meaning violations of the Foreign Trade Act and other trade-related laws) involving persons violating Article 43 of the Foreign Trade Act

⑥ The Head of the International Investigation Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Apr. 29, 2009; Dec. 30, 2009; Nov. 17, 2010; Mar. 30, 2021; Dec. 19, 2023; Feb. 25, 2025>
1. Deleted <Mar. 30, 2021>

rows.source_ko: 2. 마약류 사범(우리나라와 외국을 왕래하는 항공기 또는 선박이 입ㆍ출항하는 공항ㆍ항만과 보세구역 안에서 발생하는 마약류 사범에 한정한다)에 대한 범칙수사업무의 기획ㆍ지도 및 조정
rows.text_en: 2. Planning, guidance and coordination of investigations into narcotics offenses (limited to offenses occurring at airports, seaports and bonded areas where aircraft or vessels traveling between Korea and foreign countries arrive or depart)

rows.source_ko: 3. 마약류 관련 국내ㆍ외 관계기관 및 국제기구와의 협력
rows.text_en: 3. Cooperation with domestic and foreign agencies and international organizations in narcotics-related matters

rows.source_ko: 4. 마약류 관련 정보시스템의 운영
rows.text_en: 4. Operation of information systems relating to narcotics

rows.source_ko: 5. 마약 및 폭발물 탐지견(이하 “탐지견”이라 한다)의 운용
rows.text_en: 5. Deployment and operation of narcotics and explosives detection dogs (hereinafter referred to as “detection dogs”)

rows.source_ko: 6. 주한 미합중국 군대의 지위협정 위반사범에 관한 범칙수사업무의 기획ㆍ지도 및 조정
rows.text_en: 6. Planning, guidance and coordination of investigations into violations of the Status of Forces Agreement concerning the United States Armed Forces in Korea
7. Deleted <Feb. 25, 2025>
8. Deleted <Dec. 19, 2023>
9. Deleted <Feb. 19, 2026>
10. Deleted <Feb. 25, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 11. 제2호 및 제6호와 관련된 국내ㆍ외 정보의 수집ㆍ분석 및 관리
rows.text_en: 11. Collection, analysis and management of domestic and overseas information concerning subparagraphs 2 and 6

rows.source_ko: ⑦ 무역안보조사팀장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <신설 2026. 2. 19.>
rows.text_en: ⑦ The Head of the Trade Security Investigation Team shall be responsible for the following matters. <Newly added Feb. 19, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 1. 무역사범에 관한 범칙수사업무의 기획ㆍ지도 및 조정(「대외무역법 시행령」 제91조제4항제3호에 따른 수입물품 원산지표시 일제단속을 포함한다)
rows.text_en: 1. Planning, guidance and coordination of investigations into trade offenses (including nationwide crackdowns on country-of-origin labeling of imported goods under Article 91 (4) 3 of the Enforcement Decree of the Foreign Trade Act)

rows.source_ko: 2. 첨단기술에 관한 문서 및 물품에 관한 범칙수사업무의 기획ㆍ지도 및 조정
rows.text_en: 2. Planning, guidance and coordination of investigations into offenses involving documents and goods concerning advanced technologies

rows.source_ko: 3. 관세청 소관 방첩업무 및 방첩 유관기관과의 협력 업무
rows.text_en: 3. Counterintelligence duties under the jurisdiction of the Korea Customs Service and cooperation with related counterintelligence agencies

rows.source_ko: 4. 외국인 국제범죄정보의 수집ㆍ분석 및 관리(관세청 소관사항으로 한정한다)
rows.text_en: 4. Collection, analysis and management of information on international crimes involving foreign nationals (limited to matters under the jurisdiction of the Korea Customs Service)

rows.source_ko: 5. 관세청장이 특별히 지시한 사항의 조사ㆍ수사 및 조정
rows.text_en: 5. Investigations, criminal investigations and coordination of matters specifically directed by the Commissioner of the Korea Customs Service
[Title Amended Mar. 30, 2021]

rows.source_ko: 제7조(국제관세협력국) ① 국제관세협력국장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 7 (International Customs Cooperation Bureau) ① The Director-General of the International Customs Cooperation Bureau shall be appointed from among general-service public officials in the Senior Civil Service, with the position classified as Grade B.

rows.source_ko: ② 국제관세협력국에 국제협력총괄과ㆍ자유무역협정집행과ㆍ원산지검증과 및 해외통관지원팀을 두되, 국제협력총괄과장ㆍ자유무역협정집행과장 및 원산지검증과장은 부이사관 또는 서기관으로 보하고, 해외통관지원팀장은 서기관 또는 행정사무관으로 보한다.
rows.text_en: ② The International Customs Cooperation Bureau shall have an International Cooperation Coordination Division, Free Trade Agreement Implementation Division, Origin Verification Division and Overseas Customs Clearance Support Team. The heads of the first three divisions shall be Deputy Directors-General or Directors, and the Head of the Overseas Customs Clearance Support Team shall be a Director or Administrative Officer.
③ The Head of the International Cooperation Coordination Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Dec. 14, 2021; Feb. 28, 2023; Feb. 25, 2025; Sep. 23, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 세계관세기구 및 세계무역기구와의 협상지원 및 협력
rows.text_en: 1. Support for negotiations and cooperation with the World Customs Organization and World Trade Organization

rows.source_ko: 2. 아시아태평양경제협력체ㆍ아시아유럽정상회의 등 국제기구와의 관세 관련 협상지원 및 협력
rows.text_en: 2. Support for negotiations and cooperation on customs matters with international organizations and forums, including Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation and the Asia-Europe Meeting

rows.source_ko: 3. 세계무역기구협정 및 「세관절차의 간소화 및 조화에 관한 국제협약」 등 관세행정과 관련된 국제협약의 협상에 대한 지원
rows.text_en: 3. Support for negotiations concerning international agreements relating to customs administration, including WTO agreements and the International Convention on the Simplification and Harmonization of Customs Procedures

rows.text_en: 3. Advance examination of tariff classification of imported and exported goods and replies to civil inquiries

rows.source_ko: 4. 품목분류위원회 심의안건의 작성에 관한 사항

6. Deleted <Mar. 30, 2021>

rows.source_ko: 제10조의5(품목분류2과ㆍ품목분류3과ㆍ품목분류4과) 품목분류2과장ㆍ품목분류3과장 및 품목분류4과장은 제10조의4 각 호의 사항 중 관세평가분류원장이 지정하는 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2014. 3. 5., 2017. 2. 28.>
rows.text_en: Article 10-5 (Tariff Classification Divisions 2, 3 and 4) The heads of Tariff Classification Divisions 2, 3 and 4 shall be responsible for the matters listed in the subparagraphs of Article 10-4 that are designated by the Director of the Customs Valuation and Classification Institute. <Amended Mar. 5, 2014; Feb. 28, 2017>

[Newly inserted Sep. 28, 2007]
[Title Amended Feb. 28, 2017]
[Former Article 10-5 moved to Article 10-6 <Sep. 28, 2007>]
Article 10-6 Deleted <Sep. 26, 2013>

rows.source_ko: 제10조의7(수출입안전심사1과) 수출입안전심사1과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: Article 10-7 (Import and Export Safety Review Division 1) The Head of Import and Export Safety Review Division 1 shall be responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 수출입 안전관리 우수업체의 공인 및 공인 갱신을 위한 심사에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 1. Audits for initial accreditation and renewal of Authorized Economic Operators

rows.source_ko: 2. 수출입 안전관리 기준 연구 및 공인심사기법의 개발
rows.text_en: 2. Research on import and export security management standards and development of accreditation audit methods

rows.source_ko: 3. 수출입 안전관리 우수 공인업체에 대한 국가 간 상호 인정을 위한 심사에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Audits for mutual recognition between countries of accredited Authorized Economic Operators
[Newly inserted Apr. 16, 2012]

rows.source_ko: 제10조의8(수출입안전심사2과) 수출입안전심사2과장은 제10조의7 각 호의 사항 중 관세평가분류원장이 지정하는 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: Article 10-8 (Import and Export Safety Review Division 2) The Head of Import and Export Safety Review Division 2 shall be responsible for the matters listed in Article 10-7 that are designated by the Director of the Customs Valuation and Classification Institute.
[Newly inserted Apr. 16, 2012]
Chapter 5 Customs Offices <Amended Apr. 15, 2005; Jan. 2, 2006>

rows.source_ko: 제1절 세관
rows.text_en: Section 1 Customs Offices

rows.source_ko: 제11조(세관) ① 인천공항세관장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 가등급으로 하고, 서울세관장ㆍ부산세관장ㆍ인천세관장ㆍ대구세관장 및 광주세관장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 하며, 평택세관장은 부이사관 또는 서기관으로, 그 밖의 세관장은 서기관으로 보한다. 다만, 경남남부세관장 및 목포세관장은 과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로, 성남세관장ㆍ파주세관장ㆍ경남서부세관장ㆍ전주세관장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ공업사무관ㆍ해양수산사무관ㆍ전산사무관ㆍ방송통신사무관 또는 행정사무관으로, 김포공항세관장 및 울산세관장은 「행정기관의 조직과 정원에 관한 통칙」 제27조제3항에 따라 상호이체하여 배정ㆍ운영하는 부이사관 또는 서기관으로 보할 수 있다. <개정 2016. 1. 18., 2023. 4. 11., 2023. 8. 30., 2024. 7. 2., 2026. 2. 19.>
rows.text_en: Article 11 (Customs Offices) ① The Head of Incheon Airport Customs shall be a general-service public official in the Senior Civil Service at Grade A. The heads of Seoul, Busan, Incheon, Daegu and Gwangju Customs shall be general-service public officials in the Senior Civil Service at Grade B; the Head of Pyeongtaek Customs shall be a Deputy Director-General or Director, and the heads of other customs offices shall be Directors. However, the heads of Southern Gyeongnam Customs and Mokpo Customs may be Science and Technology Directors or Directors; the heads of Seongnam, Paju, Western Gyeongnam and Jeonju Customs may be Science and Technology Directors, Directors, Industrial Administrative Officers, Maritime and Fisheries Officers, Information Technology Officers, Broadcasting and Telecommunications Officers or Administrative Officers; and the heads of Gimpo Airport Customs and Ulsan Customs may be Deputy Directors-General or Directors assigned through inter-position transfer under Article 27 (3) of the General Rules on the Organization and Staffing of Administrative Agencies. <Amended Jan. 18, 2016; Apr. 11, 2023; Aug. 30, 2023; Jul. 2, 2024; Feb. 19, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ② 국장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로 보한다. 다만, 서울세관 통관국장ㆍ부산세관 감시국장 및 인천세관 조사국장은 과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로 보한다. <개정 2016. 1. 18., 2019. 12. 3., 2023. 4. 11., 2023. 8. 30.>
rows.text_en: ② Bureau directors shall be Deputy Directors-General, Science and Technology Directors or Directors. However, the Director of the Customs Clearance Bureau at Seoul Customs, the Director of the Surveillance Bureau at Busan Customs and the Director of the Investigation Bureau at Incheon Customs shall be Science and Technology Directors or Directors. <Amended Jan. 18, 2016; Dec. 3, 2019; Apr. 11, 2023; Aug. 30, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ③ 인천공항세관에 세관운영과ㆍ감사담당관 및 협업검사센터를 두고, 통관감시국에 수출입물류과ㆍ통관정보과ㆍ물류감시1과ㆍ물류감시2과ㆍ수입통관1과ㆍ수입통관2과ㆍ수출통관과ㆍ장비관리과ㆍ전산정보관리과ㆍ심사정보과 및 분석실을, 여행자통관1국에 여행자통관1과, 여행자통관검사관 9명 및 여행자정보분석과를, 여행자통관2국에 여행자통관2과 및 여행자통관검사관 8명을, 특송우편통관국에 특송우편총괄과ㆍ특송통관1과ㆍ특송통관2과ㆍ특송통관3과ㆍ우편통관과 및 우편검사과를, 조사국에 조사총괄과, 조사관 2명, 마약조사1과, 마약조사2과 및 마약조사3과를 둔다. <개정 2023. 4. 11., 2025. 12. 30., 2026. 3. 31.>
rows.text_en: ③ Incheon Airport Customs shall have a Customs Operations Division, an Audit Officer and a Collaborative Inspection Center. The Customs Clearance and Surveillance Bureau shall have Import and Export Logistics, Customs Clearance Information, Logistics Surveillance 1 and 2, Import Clearance 1 and 2, Export Clearance, Equipment Management, Computerized Information Management and Audit Information Divisions, and an Analysis Office. Traveler Clearance Bureau 1 shall have Traveler Clearance Division 1, nine Traveler Clearance Inspectors and a Traveler Information Analysis Division; Traveler Clearance Bureau 2 shall have Traveler Clearance Division 2 and eight Traveler Clearance Inspectors. The Express and Postal Customs Clearance Bureau shall have an Express and Postal Coordination Division, Express Clearance Divisions 1, 2 and 3, a Postal Clearance Division and a Postal Inspection Division. The Investigation Bureau shall have an Investigation Coordination Division, two Investigators and Narcotics Investigation Divisions 1, 2 and 3. <Amended Apr. 11, 2023; Dec. 30, 2025; Mar. 31, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ④ 서울세관에 세관운영과ㆍ납세자보호담당관ㆍ감사담당관 및 수출입기업지원센터를 두고, 통관국에 수출입물류과ㆍ수입통관과ㆍ수출통관과 및 이사화물과를, 심사1국에 심사총괄1과, 심사관 3명, 심사정보과, 환급심사과, 체납관리과 및 분석실을, 심사2국에 심사총괄2과, 심사관 7명, 자유무역협정검증1과, 자유무역협정검증2과 및 자유무역협정검증3과를, 조사1국에 조사총괄과, 조사관 2명, 특수조사과, 디지털무역범죄조사과 및 조사정보과를, 조사2국에 외환조사총괄과, 외환조사관 3명, 외환검사과 및 외환검사관 2명을 둔다. <개정 2021. 3. 30., 2025. 12. 30., 2026. 2. 19.>
rows.text_en: ④ Seoul Customs shall have a Customs Operations Division, a Taxpayer Protection Officer, an Audit Officer and an Import and Export Enterprise Support Center. The Customs Clearance Bureau shall have Import and Export Logistics, Import Clearance, Export Clearance and Household Goods Divisions. Audit Bureau 1 shall have Audit Coordination Division 1, three Auditors, an Audit Information Division, a Duty Drawback Audit Division, an Arrears Management Division and an Analysis Office. Audit Bureau 2 shall have Audit Coordination Division 2, seven Auditors and Free Trade Agreement Verification Divisions 1, 2 and 3. Investigation Bureau 1 shall have an Investigation Coordination Division, two Investigators, a Special Investigation Division, a Digital Trade Crime Investigation Division and an Investigation Information Division. Investigation Bureau 2 shall have a Foreign Exchange Investigation Coordination Division, three Foreign Exchange Investigators, a Foreign Exchange Inspection Division and two Foreign Exchange Inspectors. <Amended Mar. 30, 2021; Dec. 30, 2025; Feb. 19, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 부산세관에 세관운영과ㆍ감사담당관ㆍ수출입기업지원센터 및 협업검사센터를 두고, 통관국에 통관총괄과ㆍ수입통관1과ㆍ수입통관2과ㆍ수입통관3과ㆍ수출통관과ㆍ화물검사과를, 감시국에 수출입물류과, 물류감시과, 물류감시관 3명, 여행자통관과 및 장비관리과를, 신항통관감시국에 신항통관감시과ㆍ신항물류감시과ㆍ신항수입통관1과ㆍ신항수입통관2과 및 신항수출통관과를, 심사국에 심사총괄과, 심사관 2명, 자유무역협정검증과, 심사정보과, 체납관리과, 분석실 및 분석관을, 조사국에 조사총괄과, 조사관 3명, 외환조사과ㆍ무역안보조사과 및 조사정보과를 둔다. <개정 2021. 3. 30., 2025. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ Busan Customs shall have a Customs Operations Division, an Audit Officer, an Import and Export Enterprise Support Center and a Collaborative Inspection Center. The Customs Clearance Bureau shall have a Customs Clearance Coordination Division, Import Clearance Divisions 1, 2 and 3, an Export Clearance Division and a Cargo Inspection Division. The Surveillance Bureau shall have Import and Export Logistics and Logistics Surveillance Divisions, three Logistics Surveillance Officers, a Traveler Clearance Division and an Equipment Management Division. The New Port Customs Clearance and Surveillance Bureau shall have a New Port Clearance and Surveillance Division, a New Port Logistics Surveillance Division, New Port Import Clearance Divisions 1 and 2 and a New Port Export Clearance Division. The Audit Bureau shall have an Audit Coordination Division, two Auditors, a Free Trade Agreement Verification Division, an Audit Information Division, an Arrears Management Division, an Analysis Office and an Analyst. The Investigation Bureau shall have an Investigation Coordination Division, three Investigators, a Foreign Exchange Investigation Division, a Trade Security Investigation Division and an Investigation Information Division. <Amended Mar. 30, 2021; Dec. 30, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 인천세관에 세관운영과ㆍ감사담당관 및 수출입기업지원센터를 두고, 통관감시국에 수출입물류과ㆍ통관정보과ㆍ물류감시1과ㆍ물류감시2과ㆍ수입통관1과ㆍ수입통관2과ㆍ수출통관과ㆍ화물검사과ㆍ특송통관과ㆍ신항통관과ㆍ여행자통관과를, 심사국에 심사총괄과, 심사관 3명, 자유무역협정검증1과, 자유무역협정검증2과, 심사정보과 및 분석실을, 조사국에 조사총괄과, 조사관 3명, 무역안보조사과 및 조사정보과를 둔다. <신설 2023. 4. 11., 2025. 12. 30., 2026. 2. 19.>
rows.text_en: ⑥ Incheon Customs shall have a Customs Operations Division, an Audit Officer and an Import and Export Enterprise Support Center. The Customs Clearance and Surveillance Bureau shall have Import and Export Logistics, Customs Clearance Information, Logistics Surveillance 1 and 2, Import Clearance 1 and 2, Export Clearance, Cargo Inspection, Express Clearance, New Port Clearance and Traveler Clearance Divisions. The Audit Bureau shall have an Audit Coordination Division, three Auditors, Free Trade Agreement Verification Divisions 1 and 2, an Audit Information Division and an Analysis Office. The Investigation Bureau shall have an Investigation Coordination Division, three Investigators, a Trade Security Investigation Division and an Investigation Information Division. <Newly added Apr. 11, 2023; Amended Dec. 30, 2025; Feb. 19, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ⑦ 대구세관에 세관운영과ㆍ감사담당관ㆍ수출입기업지원센터ㆍ통관지원과ㆍ납세지원과ㆍ심사과ㆍ조사과 및 여행자통관과를 두고, 광주세관에 세관운영과ㆍ감사담당관ㆍ수출입기업지원센터ㆍ통관지원과ㆍ심사과ㆍ조사과 및 여행자통관과를 둔다. <개정 2021. 3. 30., 2023. 4. 11.>
rows.text_en: ⑦ Daegu Customs shall have a Customs Operations Division, an Audit Officer, an Import and Export Enterprise Support Center, a Customs Clearance Support Division, a Taxpayer Support Division, an Audit Division, an Investigation Division and a Traveler Clearance Division. Gwangju Customs shall have a Customs Operations Division, an Audit Officer, an Import and Export Enterprise Support Center, a Customs Clearance Support Division, an Audit Division, an Investigation Division and a Traveler Clearance Division. <Amended Mar. 30, 2021; Apr. 11, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ⑧ 평택세관에 통관총괄과ㆍ통관검사과ㆍ특송통관과ㆍ물류감시과ㆍ심사과ㆍ조사과 및 여행자통관과를 둔다. <개정 2021. 3. 30., 2022. 2. 22., 2023. 4. 11.>
rows.text_en: ⑧ Pyeongtaek Customs shall have a Customs Clearance Coordination Division, Customs Clearance Inspection Division, Express Clearance Division, Logistics Surveillance Division, Audit Division, Investigation Division and Traveler Clearance Division. <Amended Mar. 30, 2021; Feb. 22, 2022; Apr. 11, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ⑨ 울산세관에 통관지원과ㆍ조사심사과ㆍ감시과 및 감시관을 둔다. <개정 2016. 1. 18., 2023. 4. 11.>
rows.text_en: ⑨ Ulsan Customs shall have a Customs Clearance Support Division, Investigation and Audit Division, Surveillance Division and Surveillance Officer. <Amended Jan. 18, 2016; Apr. 11, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ⑩ 김포공항세관ㆍ김해공항세관ㆍ청주세관 및 제주세관에 통관지원과ㆍ조사심사과 및 여행자통관과를 둔다. <개정 2016. 1. 18., 2016. 2. 29., 2018. 11. 29., 2021. 3. 30., 2023. 4. 11.>
rows.text_en: ⑩ Gimpo Airport Customs, Gimhae Airport Customs, Cheongju Customs and Jeju Customs shall each have a Customs Clearance Support Division, Investigation and Audit Division and Traveler Clearance Division. <Amended Jan. 18, 2016; Feb. 29, 2016; Nov. 29, 2018; Mar. 30, 2021; Apr. 11, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ⑪ 수원세관ㆍ안산세관ㆍ안양세관ㆍ천안세관ㆍ용당세관ㆍ양산세관ㆍ창원세관ㆍ마산세관ㆍ경남남부세관ㆍ구미세관ㆍ포항세관ㆍ속초세관ㆍ광양세관ㆍ목포세관ㆍ대전세관 및 여수세관에 통관지원과 및 조사심사과를 둔다. <개정 2016. 1. 18., 2016. 2. 29., 2018. 11. 29., 2019. 12. 3., 2023. 4. 11., 2026. 3. 31.>
rows.text_en: ⑪ Suwon, Ansan, Anyang, Cheonan, Yongdang, Yangsan, Changwon, Masan, Southern Gyeongnam, Gumi, Pohang, Sokcho, Gwangyang, Mokpo, Daejeon and Yeosu Customs shall each have a Customs Clearance Support Division and an Investigation and Audit Division. <Amended Jan. 18, 2016; Feb. 29, 2016; Nov. 29, 2018; Dec. 3, 2019; Apr. 11, 2023; Mar. 31, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ⑫ 군산세관에 통관지원과ㆍ특송통관과 및 조사심사과를 둔다. <신설 2026. 3. 31.>
rows.text_en: ⑫ Gunsan Customs shall have a Customs Clearance Support Division, Express Clearance Division and Investigation and Audit Division. <Newly added Mar. 31, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ⑬ 제3항에 따른 세관운영과장은 과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로, 감사담당관ㆍ협업검사센터장ㆍ수출입물류과장ㆍ통관정보과장ㆍ장비관리과장ㆍ전산정보관리과장ㆍ분석실장ㆍ여행자통관1과장ㆍ여행자통관2과장ㆍ특송우편총괄과장ㆍ조사총괄과장 및 마약조사1과장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ공업사무관ㆍ해양수산사무관ㆍ전산사무관ㆍ방송통신사무관 또는 행정사무관으로, 그 밖의 과장ㆍ조사관 및 검사관은 공업사무관ㆍ해양수산사무관ㆍ전산사무관ㆍ방송통신사무관 또는 행정사무관으로 보한다. <개정 2023. 12. 19., 2026. 3. 31.>
rows.text_en: ⑬ Under paragraph 3, the Head of the Customs Operations Division shall be a Science and Technology Director or Director. The Audit Officer, Head of the Collaborative Inspection Center, heads of Import and Export Logistics, Customs Clearance Information, Equipment Management, Computerized Information Management, Analysis Office, Traveler Clearance Divisions 1 and 2, Express and Postal Coordination, Investigation Coordination and Narcotics Investigation Division 1 shall be Science and Technology Directors, Directors, Industrial Administrative Officers, Maritime and Fisheries Officers, Information Technology Officers, Broadcasting and Telecommunications Officers or Administrative Officers. Other division heads, Investigators and Inspectors shall be Industrial Administrative Officers, Maritime and Fisheries Officers, Information Technology Officers, Broadcasting and Telecommunications Officers or Administrative Officers. <Amended Dec. 19, 2023; Mar. 31, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ⑭ 제4항부터 제9항까지의 규정에 따른 세관운영과장ㆍ감사담당관ㆍ수출입기업지원센터장 및 협업검사센터장, 서울세관의 수출입물류과장ㆍ수입통관과장ㆍ이사화물과장ㆍ심사총괄1과장ㆍ체납관리과장ㆍ심사총괄2과장ㆍ자유무역협정검증1과장ㆍ조사총괄과장ㆍ특수조사과장ㆍ외환조사총괄과장 및 외환검사과장, 부산세관의 통관총괄과장ㆍ수입통관1과장ㆍ수출입물류과장ㆍ물류감시과장ㆍ장비관리과장ㆍ신항통관감시과장ㆍ신항수입통관1과장ㆍ심사총괄과장ㆍ자유무역협정검증과장ㆍ분석실장ㆍ조사총괄과장 및 외환조사과장, 인천세관의 수출입물류과장ㆍ통관정보과장ㆍ여행자통관과장ㆍ심사총괄과장ㆍ자유무역협정검증1과장 및 조사총괄과장, 대구세관ㆍ광주세관ㆍ울산세관의 통관지원과장 및 평택세관의 통관총괄과장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ공업사무관ㆍ해양수산사무관ㆍ전산사무관ㆍ방송통신사무관 또는 행정사무관으로, 그 밖의 과장ㆍ담당관ㆍ심사관ㆍ조사관ㆍ검사관ㆍ감시관ㆍ분석실장 및 분석관은 공업사무관ㆍ해양수산사무관ㆍ전산사무관ㆍ방송통신사무관 또는 행정사무관으로 보한다. <개정 2023. 12. 19., 2025. 12. 30., 2026. 3. 31.>
rows.text_en: ⑭ Under paragraphs 4 through 9, the heads of Customs Operations Divisions, Audit Officers, Heads of Import and Export Enterprise Support Centers and Heads of Collaborative Inspection Centers; at Seoul Customs, the heads of Import and Export Logistics, Import Clearance, Household Goods, Audit Coordination 1, Arrears Management, Audit Coordination 2, Free Trade Agreement Verification 1, Investigation Coordination, Special Investigation, Foreign Exchange Investigation Coordination and Foreign Exchange Inspection Divisions; at Busan Customs, the heads of Customs Clearance Coordination, Import Clearance 1, Import and Export Logistics, Logistics Surveillance, Equipment Management, New Port Customs Clearance and Surveillance, New Port Import Clearance 1, Audit Coordination, Free Trade Agreement Verification, Analysis Office, Investigation Coordination and Foreign Exchange Investigation Divisions; at Incheon Customs, the heads of Import and Export Logistics, Customs Clearance Information, Traveler Clearance, Audit Coordination, Free Trade Agreement Verification 1 and Investigation Coordination Divisions; the heads of Customs Clearance Support Divisions at Daegu, Gwangju and Ulsan Customs; and the Head of the Customs Clearance Coordination Division at Pyeongtaek Customs shall be Science and Technology Directors, Directors, Industrial Administrative Officers, Maritime and Fisheries Officers, Information Technology Officers, Broadcasting and Telecommunications Officers or Administrative Officers. Other division heads, officers, Auditors, Investigators, Inspectors, Surveillance Officers, Heads of Analysis Offices and Analysts shall be Industrial Administrative Officers, Maritime and Fisheries Officers, Information Technology Officers, Broadcasting and Telecommunications Officers or Administrative Officers. <Amended Dec. 19, 2023; Dec. 30, 2025; Mar. 31, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ⑮ 제10항부터 제12항까지에 따른 각 과장은 공업사무관ㆍ해양수산사무관ㆍ전산사무관ㆍ방송통신사무관 또는 행정사무관으로 보한다. 다만, 용당세관ㆍ대전세관의 통관지원과장은 공업사무관ㆍ전산사무관ㆍ행정사무관 또는 관세주사로 보한다. <개정 2023. 12. 19., 2026. 3. 31.>
rows.text_en: ⑮ The heads of the respective divisions under paragraphs 10 through 12 shall be Industrial Administrative Officers, Maritime and Fisheries Officers, Information Technology Officers, Broadcasting and Telecommunications Officers or Administrative Officers. However, the Heads of the Customs Clearance Support Divisions at Yongdang and Daejeon Customs shall be Industrial Administrative Officers, Information Technology Officers, Administrative Officers or Customs Senior Inspectors. <Amended Dec. 19, 2023; Mar. 31, 2026>
⑯ Deleted <Jan. 18, 2016>
⑰ Deleted <Jan. 18, 2016>
⑱ Deleted <Jan. 18, 2016>

rows.source_ko: 제2절 세관관서의 사무분장
rows.text_en: Section 2 Allocation of Duties among Customs Offices

rows.source_ko: 제12조(부산세관의 과단위 사무분장) ① 세관운영과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2024. 2. 27.>
rows.text_en: Article 12 (Allocation of Division-Level Duties at Busan Customs) ① The Head of the Customs Operations Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Feb. 27, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 1. 공무원의 임용ㆍ복무ㆍ교육훈련ㆍ연금ㆍ복리후생ㆍ기타 인사사무
rows.text_en: 1. Appointment, service, education and training, pensions, welfare and other personnel matters concerning public officials

rows.source_ko: 2. 관인 및 관인대장의 관리
rows.text_en: 2. Management of official seals and the register of official seals

rows.source_ko: 3. 보안
rows.text_en: 3. Security

rows.source_ko: 4. 문서의 접수ㆍ발송ㆍ심사ㆍ보존 등 문서관리
rows.text_en: 4. Management of documents, including receipt, dispatch, examination and preservation

rows.source_ko: 5. 예산집행 및 결산
rows.text_en: 5. Budget execution and settlement of accounts

rows.source_ko: 6. 청사ㆍ시설 및 장비의 안전관리
rows.text_en: 6. Safety management of office buildings, facilities and equipment

rows.source_ko: 7. 물품의 구매 및 조달
rows.text_en: 7. Purchasing and procurement of supplies

rows.source_ko: 8. 국유재산 등 시설 및 물품의 관리
rows.text_en: 8. Management of facilities and supplies, including state-owned property

rows.source_ko: 9. 유ㆍ무선통신 업무
rows.text_en: 9. Wired and wireless communications affairs

rows.source_ko: 10. 사업진도의 파악과 심사평가
rows.text_en: 10. Monitoring project progress and conducting reviews and evaluations

rows.source_ko: 11. 관세행정업무에 관한 홍보 및 언론보도 내용의 확인ㆍ정정보도 등에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 11. Public relations concerning customs administration and matters involving verification and correction of press reports

rows.source_ko: 12. 권역내 세관에 대한 서무ㆍ인사ㆍ회계ㆍ예산 등 총무업무의 지원 및 지도ㆍ감독
rows.text_en: 12. Support, guidance and supervision of general administrative affairs, including clerical work, personnel, accounting and budgets, at customs offices in the jurisdictional region

rows.source_ko: 13. 해당 세관과 권역내 세관의 전산시스템망 운영과 전산장비 관리
rows.text_en: 13. Operation of computerized networks and management of computer equipment at the customs office and other customs offices in its jurisdictional region

rows.source_ko: 14. 세관서비스헌장의 운영에 관한 업무
rows.text_en: 14. Operation of the Customs Service Charter

rows.source_ko: 15. 기관평가에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 15. Matters concerning institutional evaluation

rows.source_ko: 16. 관세민원서비스의 개선
rows.text_en: 16. Improvement of customs civil petition services

rows.source_ko: 17. 관세민원제도의 개선
rows.text_en: 17. Improvement of systems for customs-related civil petitions

rows.source_ko: 18. 관세에 관한 이의신청과 과세전적부심사에 관한 업무
rows.text_en: 18. Matters concerning objections to customs duties and pre-assessment review of taxation

rows.source_ko: 19. 통관업의 신고접수 및 업무감독
rows.text_en: 19. Receipt of notifications of customs clearance business and supervision of its operations

rows.source_ko: 20. 통관고유부호 및 해외거래처부호 부여 및 관리
rows.text_en: 20. Issuance and management of customs clearance identification codes and overseas business partner codes

rows.source_ko: 21. 납세자의 권리보호에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 21. Matters concerning protection of taxpayers' rights

rows.source_ko: 22. 그 밖에 다른 국ㆍ실ㆍ과 및 담당관의 주관에 속하지 않는 사항
rows.text_en: 22. Other matters not under the jurisdiction of other bureaus, offices, divisions or officers

rows.source_ko: ② 감사담당관은 다음 사항에 관하여 세관장을 보좌한다.
rows.text_en: ② The Audit Officer shall assist the Head of Customs with the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 해당 세관과 관세청장이 지정하는 세관 및 관련단체에 대한 감사
rows.text_en: 1. Audits of the customs office, customs offices designated by the Commissioner of the Korea Customs Service, and related organizations

rows.source_ko: 2. 다른 기관에 의한 감사결과의 처리
rows.text_en: 2. Handling of audit findings issued by other agencies

rows.source_ko: 3. 사정업무에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning inspection and investigation duties

rows.source_ko: 4. 해당 세관과 관세청장이 지정하는 세관의 소속공무원에 대한 복무의무 위반사항의 조사ㆍ처리
rows.text_en: 4. Investigation and handling of violations of official duties by public officials of the customs office and customs offices designated by the Commissioner

rows.source_ko: 5. 해당 세관과 관세청장이 지정하는 세관의 소속공무원에 대한 비위사항과 비위관련 진정의 조사ㆍ처리
rows.text_en: 5. Investigation and handling of misconduct and related complaints concerning public officials of the customs office and designated customs offices

rows.source_ko: 6. 감사에 관한 통계의 유지 및 비위사항에 관한 요인의 분석
rows.text_en: 6. Maintenance of audit statistics and analysis of factors relating to misconduct

rows.source_ko: 7. 고객만족도의 측정 및 개선에 관한 업무
rows.text_en: 7. Measurement and improvement of customer satisfaction

rows.source_ko: 8. 진정 및 납세자 피해에 대한 조사ㆍ처분
rows.text_en: 8. Investigation and disposition of complaints and harm suffered by taxpayers

rows.source_ko: 9. 그 밖의 감사업무에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 9. Other matters relating to audit duties

rows.source_ko: ③ 수출입기업지원센터장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The Head of the Import and Export Enterprise Support Center shall be responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 자유무역협정관세의 활용과 관련한 교육ㆍ홍보 및 기업의 고충 처리 등 기업지원에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 1. Support for businesses, including education, publicity and handling business difficulties relating to use of preferential tariffs under free trade agreements

rows.source_ko: 2. 국내외 수출입통관 애로 해소 및 지원에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 2. Resolution of and support concerning difficulties with import and export customs clearance domestically and abroad

rows.source_ko: 3. 자유무역협정 인증수출자의 지정 및 사후관리와 인증수출자 제도 관련 상담에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Designation and follow-up management of approved exporters under free trade agreements, and consultation on the approved exporter system

rows.source_ko: 4. 원산지증명서의 발급에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning issuance of certificates of origin

rows.source_ko: ④ 협업검사센터장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ④ The Head of the Collaborative Inspection Center shall be responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 협업검사 관련부처와 협력업무
rows.text_en: 1. Cooperation with ministries and agencies involved in collaborative inspections

rows.source_ko: 2. 검사대상 선별 기준 개발 및 운영
rows.text_en: 2. Development and operation of criteria for selecting inspection targets

rows.source_ko: 3. 검사대상 물품의 안전성 최종 판단 및 통관여부 결정
rows.text_en: 3. Final assessment of safety of goods selected for inspection and decisions on whether to grant customs clearance

rows.source_ko: 4. 위험물 분석 기법 개발 및 운영
rows.text_en: 4. Development and operation of risk-goods analysis methods

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 통관총괄과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Head of the Customs Clearance Coordination Division shall be responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 권역내 세관의 통관업무에 대한 지도ㆍ감독
rows.text_en: 1. Guidance and supervision of customs clearance operations at customs offices within the jurisdictional region

rows.source_ko: 2. 통관에 관한 정보의 수집ㆍ분석 및 종합관리
rows.text_en: 2. Collection, analysis and integrated management of information concerning customs clearance

rows.source_ko: 3. 수출입물품 및 반송물품의 세관별 검사대상 선별기준의 수립과 그 운영
rows.text_en: 3. Establishment and operation of selection criteria for inspections of imported, exported and returned goods at each customs office

rows.source_ko: 4. 관리대상화물의 선별ㆍ하역장소 지정 및 정보수집ㆍ분석
rows.text_en: 4. Selection of cargo subject to control, designation of unloading locations and collection and analysis of related information

rows.source_ko: 5. 첨부서류 없이 전자적으로 신고한 수입신고에 대한 수입통관요건의 확인 및 신고서 처리방법의 변경
rows.text_en: 5. Verification of import clearance requirements for electronic import declarations filed without supporting documents and changes to the processing method for declarations

rows.source_ko: 6. 수출입신고의 정확도 향상에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Matters concerning improvement of the accuracy of import and export declarations

rows.source_ko: 7. 그 밖에 국내 다른 과의 주관에 속하지 않는 사항
rows.text_en: 7. Other matters not under the responsibilities of other divisions within the bureau

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 수입통관1과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2025. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: ⑥ The Head of Import Clearance Division 1 shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Dec. 30, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 수입신고의 수리
rows.text_en: 1. Acceptance of import declarations

rows.source_ko: 2. 수입물품에 대한 검사ㆍ감정 및 수입통관요건의 확인
rows.text_en: 2. Inspection and appraisal of imported goods and verification of import clearance requirements
3. Deleted <Dec. 30, 2025>
4. Deleted <Dec. 30, 2025>
5. Deleted <Dec. 30, 2025>
6. Deleted <Dec. 30, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 7. 남북교역물품의 반입 관리
rows.text_en: 7. Management of goods brought into Korea for inter-Korean trade

rows.source_ko: 8. 장치기간이 경과된 화물에 대한 공매예정가격의 산출
rows.text_en: 8. Calculation of reserve auction prices for cargo exceeding the permitted storage period

rows.source_ko: 9. 감면 및 분할납부의 결정과 사전세액심사 대상물품의 세액심사
rows.text_en: 9. Decisions on customs duty reductions and installment payments, and review of tax amounts for goods subject to advance tax assessment

rows.source_ko: 10. 수입신고 수리전의 관세 및 수입관련 내국세의 징수
rows.text_en: 10. Collection of customs duties and domestic taxes on imports before acceptance of import declarations

rows.source_ko: 11. 수입신고 수리전의 관세 및 수입관련 내국세 세액의 수정ㆍ경정 및 보정
rows.text_en: 11. Amendment, correction and adjustment of customs duties and domestic taxes on imports before acceptance of import declarations
12. Deleted <Dec. 30, 2025>
13. Deleted <Dec. 30, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ⑦ 수입통관2과장 및 수입통관3과장은 제6항의 사항 중 관세청장이 지정하는 사항을 각각 분장한다. <개정 2025. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: ⑦ The heads of Import Clearance Divisions 2 and 3 shall respectively be responsible for the matters under paragraph 6 designated by the Commissioner of the Korea Customs Service. <Amended Dec. 30, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ⑧ 수출통관과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <신설 2025. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: ⑧ The Head of the Export Clearance Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Newly added Dec. 30, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 수출신고의 수리
rows.text_en: 1. Acceptance of export declarations

rows.source_ko: 2. 수출물품에 대한 검사ㆍ감정 및 수출통관요건의 확인
rows.text_en: 2. Inspection and appraisal of exported goods and verification of export clearance requirements

rows.source_ko: 3. 물품의 반송
rows.text_en: 3. Return shipment of goods

rows.source_ko: 4. 수출물품 선적의 관리
rows.text_en: 4. Management of loading of export goods

rows.source_ko: 5. 컨테이너안전협정의 이행 등에 관한 업무
rows.text_en: 5. Matters relating to implementation of the Container Safety Convention

rows.source_ko: 6. 전략물자 수출통제와 관련된 통관심사
rows.text_en: 6. Customs clearance reviews relating to export controls on strategic items

rows.source_ko: 7. 남북교역물품의 반출 관리
rows.text_en: 7. Management of goods taken out of Korea for inter-Korean trade

rows.source_ko: ⑨ 화물검사과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <신설 2025. 12. 30., 2026. 3. 31.>
rows.text_en: ⑨ The Head of the Cargo Inspection Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Newly added Dec. 30, 2025; Amended Mar. 31, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 1. 관리대상화물 중 검사대상화물의 검사
rows.text_en: 1. Inspection of cargo designated for inspection among cargo subject to control

rows.source_ko: 2. 컨테이너검색기의 관리 및 운영
rows.text_en: 2. Management and operation of container scanning equipment

rows.source_ko: 3. 제5항제4호의 사항 중 관세청장이 지정하는 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters under paragraph 5, subparagraph 4 designated by the Commissioner of the Korea Customs Service

rows.source_ko: 4. 제6항 각 호의 사항 중 관세청장이 지정하는 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Matters under the subparagraphs of paragraph 6 designated by the Commissioner of the Korea Customs Service

rows.source_ko: ⑩ 수출입물류과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2025. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: ⑩ The Head of the Import and Export Logistics Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Dec. 30, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 보세구역의 지정 및 특허와 보세화물의 관리
rows.text_en: 1. Designation and licensing of bonded areas and management of bonded cargo

rows.source_ko: 2. 자유무역지역 및 종합보세구역의 관리
rows.text_en: 2. Management of free trade zones and comprehensive bonded areas

rows.source_ko: 3. 수출입화물의 입항ㆍ하역ㆍ보관ㆍ운송ㆍ적재 및 물류의 개선
rows.text_en: 3. Arrival, unloading, storage, transport and loading of imported and exported cargo, and improvement of logistics

rows.source_ko: 4. 입출항적재화물목록의 관리
rows.text_en: 4. Management of inbound and outbound cargo manifests

rows.source_ko: 5. 수입보세화물 총량의 관리
rows.text_en: 5. Management of the total volume of imported bonded cargo

rows.source_ko: 6. 수출입물류업체(보세구역, 종합보세구역, 자유무역지역 입주업체 및 보세운송업체에 한정한다)의 법규수행능력평가 측정 및 관리
rows.text_en: 6. Measurement and management of compliance assessments for import and export logistics businesses (limited to bonded areas, comprehensive bonded areas, enterprises operating in free trade zones and bonded transport operators)

rows.source_ko: 7. 장치기간경과화물ㆍ몰수품 및 국고귀속물 품의 관리ㆍ공매 및 매각
rows.text_en: 7. Management, public auction and sale of cargo exceeding storage periods, confiscated goods and goods reverted to the National Treasury

rows.source_ko: 8. 외국인투자에 대한 통관지원
rows.text_en: 8. Customs clearance support for foreign investment

rows.source_ko: 9. 그 밖에 국내 다른 과의 주관에 속하지 않는 사항
rows.text_en: 9. Other matters not under the responsibilities of other divisions within the bureau

rows.source_ko: ⑪ 물류감시과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2025. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: ⑪ The Head of the Logistics Surveillance Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Dec. 30, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 항만 또는 공항에 대한 감시업무 총괄
rows.text_en: 1. Overall management of surveillance at seaports and airports

rows.source_ko: 2. 전자문서방식에 의한 선박 또는 항공기의 출입신고 및 자료관리
rows.text_en: 2. Electronic reporting of arrivals and departures of vessels or aircraft and management of related data

rows.source_ko: 3. 총기류ㆍ폭발물 등 테러관련 물품의 반입방지
rows.text_en: 3. Prevention of the entry of terrorism-related goods, including firearms and explosives

rows.source_ko: 4. 선박용품 또는 항공기용품의 하역 및 용역제공에 관한 업무
rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning unloading of ship or aircraft supplies and provision of related services

rows.source_ko: 5. 승선 또는 탑승허가에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 5. Matters concerning permission to board vessels or aircraft

rows.source_ko: 6. 항만용역업체 또는 공항용역업체의 관리
rows.text_en: 6. Management of seaport and airport service providers

rows.source_ko: 7. 국제무역선 또는 국제무역기에 하역하는 물품의 감시
rows.text_en: 7. Surveillance of goods loaded or unloaded on international trading vessels or aircraft

rows.source_ko: 8. 운송수단의 물품취급시간 외에 행하는 물품취급의 통보ㆍ접수 및 감시
rows.text_en: 8. Receipt of notifications and surveillance of cargo handling outside the prescribed cargo handling hours for means of transport

rows.source_ko: 9. 선박 또는 항공기로 출입국하는 여행자, 승무원, 그 밖의 출입국자에 대한 휴대품검사 및 면세통관
rows.text_en: 9. Inspection of carried goods and duty-free clearance for travelers, crew members and other persons entering or departing Korea by vessel or aircraft

rows.source_ko: 10. 선박 또는 항공기의 입출항 및 검색에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 10. Matters concerning arrival, departure and search of vessels or aircraft

rows.source_ko: 11. 감시선단의 운용 및 외항기동감시
rows.text_en: 11. Operation of surveillance vessel fleets and mobile surveillance on the open sea

rows.source_ko: 12. 해상감시에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 12. Matters concerning maritime surveillance

rows.source_ko: 13. 감시정 및 감시장비의 운용
rows.text_en: 13. Operation of surveillance boats and surveillance equipment

rows.source_ko: 14. 관리대상화물 중 감시대상화물의 현장선별ㆍ정보수집ㆍ분석 및 추적 감시ㆍ검사
